1.title: Judge Allows Postal Service Effort to Restrict Mail Voting, for Now
1.summary: The order came amid a spate of legal challenges, including one by Democratic state attorneys general, that could still result in the rules being blocked.

2.title: The South Loved Dolly Parton. It Saw the Best of Itself in Her.
2.summary: Even as her talents and work ethic opened up the world to her, she kept coming home. For many in the complicated region she’s from, that meant a lot.

3.title: US designates Palestine Action a terrorist group
3.summary: Supporting Palestine Action became illegal in the UK in 2025 after the government banned it under anti-terror legislation.

4.title: Live Updates: At Least 160 Killed and Hundreds Missing as Floods Sweep Away Villages in Nepal
4.summary: A wall of water crashed through a Himalayan river valley between Nepal and the Chinese territory of Tibet, the Nepali authorities said. The missing included border officials, port workers and foreign tourists.

5.title: 14 Newborns Die in Hospital Fire in Pakistan’s Capital
5.summary: The fire broke out at Islamabad’s largest hospital and has become a political issue. Opposition supporters shouted, “Stop killing our children!” at an official visiting the scene.

6.title: Two German airport workers die of malaria after 'mosquito arrives on plane'
6.summary: It is believed the mosquitoes arrived at Germany's busiest airport on a plane, according to German public health officials.
